\begin{tikzpicture}[on grid=false,node distance=0.8cm]
  % Narrower than the DRLD's hand-drawn maps, which are scaled to the line width anyway: the item
  % boxes keep little side padding and the recipe boxes lose most of tcolorbox's, so a map with
  % many columns comes out larger on the page. Local to this picture.
  \tikzset{every node/.append style={inner xsep=2pt}}
  \tcbset{boxsep=0.5mm, left=1mm, right=1mm}
  % tcolorbox sizes an hbox after its body alone, so the recipe name is padded to the widest raw
  % tag of the title (IFU_WCU_OFF_RAW is wider than metis_ifu_rsrf). The lengths are allocated once
  % per document, whichever map comes first.
  \ifdefined\assomapwidth\else\newlength{\assomapwidth}\newlength{\assomaptagwidth}\fi

  \matrix (recipes) [column sep=0.05cm, row sep=1cm]{
    % Header row: the raw data that triggers a task, and the recipe it runs. Column `ext` holds the
    % external and static calibration files.
    \node [above] (ext_raw)[empty]{}; &
    \node [above] (detlingain_raw){%
      \settowidth{\assomapwidth}{\REC{metis_det_lingain}}%
      \settowidth{\assomaptagwidth}{\RAW{DETLIN_GEO_RAW}}\ifdim\assomaptagwidth>\assomapwidth \assomapwidth=\assomaptagwidth \fi%
      \settowidth{\assomaptagwidth}{\RAW{N_WCU_OFF_RAW}}\ifdim\assomaptagwidth>\assomapwidth \assomapwidth=\assomaptagwidth \fi%
      \recipebox{\RAW{DETLIN_GEO_RAW} \RAW{N_WCU_OFF_RAW}}{\makebox[\assomapwidth]{\REC{metis_det_lingain}}}
    }; &
    \node [above] (nadcslitloss_raw){%
      \settowidth{\assomapwidth}{\REC{metis_n_adc_slitloss}}%
      \settowidth{\assomaptagwidth}{\RAW{N_ADC_SLITLOSS_RAW}}\ifdim\assomaptagwidth>\assomapwidth \assomapwidth=\assomaptagwidth \fi%
      \settowidth{\assomaptagwidth}{\RAW{N_WCU_OFF_RAW}}\ifdim\assomaptagwidth>\assomapwidth \assomapwidth=\assomaptagwidth \fi%
      \recipebox{\RAW{N_ADC_SLITLOSS_RAW} \RAW{N_WCU_OFF_RAW}}{\makebox[\assomapwidth]{\REC{metis_n_adc_slitloss}}}
    }; &
    \node [above] (detdark_raw){%
      \settowidth{\assomapwidth}{\REC{metis_det_dark}}%
      \settowidth{\assomaptagwidth}{\RAW{DARK_GEO_RAW}}\ifdim\assomaptagwidth>\assomapwidth \assomapwidth=\assomaptagwidth \fi%
      \recipebox{\RAW{DARK_GEO_RAW}}{\makebox[\assomapwidth]{\REC{metis_det_dark}}}
    }; &
    \node [above] (nlssrsrf_raw){%
      \settowidth{\assomapwidth}{\REC{metis_n_lss_rsrf}}%
      \settowidth{\assomaptagwidth}{\RAW{N_LSS_RSRF_RAW}}\ifdim\assomaptagwidth>\assomapwidth \assomapwidth=\assomaptagwidth \fi%
      \settowidth{\assomaptagwidth}{\RAW{N_WCU_OFF_RAW}}\ifdim\assomaptagwidth>\assomapwidth \assomapwidth=\assomaptagwidth \fi%
      \recipebox{\RAW{N_LSS_RSRF_RAW} \RAW{N_WCU_OFF_RAW}}{\makebox[\assomapwidth]{\REC{metis_n_lss_rsrf}}}
    }; &
    \node [above] (nlsstrace_raw){%
      \settowidth{\assomapwidth}{\REC{metis_n_lss_trace}}%
      \settowidth{\assomaptagwidth}{\RAW{N_LSS_RSRF_PINH_RAW}}\ifdim\assomaptagwidth>\assomapwidth \assomapwidth=\assomaptagwidth \fi%
      \settowidth{\assomaptagwidth}{\RAW{N_WCU_OFF_RAW}}\ifdim\assomaptagwidth>\assomapwidth \assomapwidth=\assomaptagwidth \fi%
      \recipebox{\RAW{N_LSS_RSRF_PINH_RAW} \RAW{N_WCU_OFF_RAW}}{\makebox[\assomapwidth]{\REC{metis_n_lss_trace}}}
    };
    \\
    % Row GAIN_MAP_GEO
    \node (ext_gainmapgeo)[empty]{}; &
    \node (detlingain_gainmapgeo)[statcalfile]{\hyperref[dataitem:gain_map_det]{\STATCALIB*{GAIN_MAP_GEO}}}; &
    \node (nadcslitloss_gainmapgeo)[connection]{}; &
    \node (detdark_gainmapgeo)[connection]{}; &
    \node (nlssrsrf_gainmapgeo)[connection]{}; &
    \node (nlsstrace_gainmapgeo)[connection]{};
    \\
    % Row LINEARITY_GEO
    \node (ext_linearitygeo)[empty]{}; &
    \node (detlingain_linearitygeo)[calibproduct]{\hyperref[dataitem:linearity_det]{\PROD*{LINEARITY_GEO}}}; &
    \node (nadcslitloss_linearitygeo)[connection]{}; &
    \node (detdark_linearitygeo)[connection]{}; &
    \node (nlssrsrf_linearitygeo)[connection]{}; &
    \node (nlsstrace_linearitygeo)[connection]{};
    \\
    % Row PERSISTENCE_MAP
    \node (ext_persistencemap)[extcalfile]{\EXTCALIB{PERSISTENCE_MAP}}; &
    \node (detlingain_persistencemap)[empty]{}; &
    \node (nadcslitloss_persistencemap)[connection]{}; &
    \node (detdark_persistencemap)[connection]{}; &
    \node (nlssrsrf_persistencemap)[connection]{}; &
    \node (nlsstrace_persistencemap)[connection]{};
    \\
    % Row MASTER_DARK_GEO
    \node (ext_masterdarkgeo)[empty]{}; &
    \node (detlingain_masterdarkgeo)[empty]{}; &
    \node (nadcslitloss_masterdarkgeo)[connection]{}; &
    \node (detdark_masterdarkgeo)[calibproduct]{\PROD{MASTER_DARK_GEO}}; &
    \node (nlssrsrf_masterdarkgeo)[connection]{}; &
    \node (nlsstrace_masterdarkgeo)[connection]{};
    \\
    % Row MASTER_N_LSS_RSRF
    \node (ext_masternlssrsrf)[empty]{}; &
    \node (detlingain_masternlssrsrf)[empty]{}; &
    \node (nadcslitloss_masternlssrsrf)[empty]{}; &
    \node (detdark_masternlssrsrf)[empty]{}; &
    \node (nlssrsrf_masternlssrsrf)[calibproduct]{\PROD{MASTER_N_LSS_RSRF}}; &
    \node (nlsstrace_masternlssrsrf)[connection]{};
    \\
    % Row N_ADC_SLITLOSS
    \node (ext_nadcslitloss)[empty]{}; &
    \node (detlingain_nadcslitloss)[empty]{}; &
    \node (nadcslitloss_nadcslitloss)[statcalfile]{\STATCALIB{N_ADC_SLITLOSS}}; &
    \node (detdark_nadcslitloss)[empty]{}; &
    \node (nlssrsrf_nadcslitloss)[empty]{}; &
    \node (nlsstrace_nadcslitloss)[empty]{};
    \\
    % Row N_LSS_TRACE
    \node (ext_nlsstrace)[empty]{}; &
    \node (detlingain_nlsstrace)[empty]{}; &
    \node (nadcslitloss_nlsstrace)[empty]{}; &
    \node (detdark_nlsstrace)[empty]{}; &
    \node (nlssrsrf_nlsstrace)[empty]{}; &
    \node (nlsstrace_nlsstrace)[calibproduct]{\PROD{N_LSS_TRACE}};
    \\
  };

  %% AIT / monthly calibrations to the left, daily calibrations and science to the right
  \node (sep_top) at ($(nadcslitloss_raw.north east)!0.5!(detdark_raw.north west)$){};
  \node (sep_bottom) at ($(nadcslitloss_nlsstrace.south east)!0.5!(detdark_nlsstrace.south west)$){};
  \draw [thick, dashed] ([yshift=5mm]sep_top.center) -- ([yshift=-5mm]sep_bottom.center);

  %% Vertical connections: a task to its products
  \draw [arrow] (detlingain_raw) -- (detlingain_gainmapgeo);
  \draw [arrow] (detlingain_gainmapgeo) -- (detlingain_linearitygeo);
  \draw [arrow] (nadcslitloss_raw) -- (nadcslitloss_nadcslitloss);
  \draw [arrow] (detdark_raw) -- (detdark_masterdarkgeo);
  \draw [arrow] (nlssrsrf_raw) -- (nlssrsrf_masternlssrsrf);
  \draw [arrow] (nlsstrace_raw) -- (nlsstrace_nlsstrace);

  %% Horizontal connections: a product to the tasks that consume it (dashed: optional for that task)
  \draw [match] (detlingain_gainmapgeo) -- (nadcslitloss_gainmapgeo);
  \draw [match] (nadcslitloss_gainmapgeo) -- (detdark_gainmapgeo);
  \draw [match] (detdark_gainmapgeo) -- (nlssrsrf_gainmapgeo);
  \draw [match] (nlssrsrf_gainmapgeo) -- (nlsstrace_gainmapgeo);
  \draw [match] (detlingain_linearitygeo) -- (nadcslitloss_linearitygeo);
  \draw [match] (nadcslitloss_linearitygeo) -- (detdark_linearitygeo);
  \draw [match] (detdark_linearitygeo) -- (nlssrsrf_linearitygeo);
  \draw [match] (nlssrsrf_linearitygeo) -- (nlsstrace_linearitygeo);
  \draw [match] (ext_persistencemap) -- (nadcslitloss_persistencemap);
  \draw [match] (nadcslitloss_persistencemap) -- (detdark_persistencemap);
  \draw [match] (detdark_persistencemap) -- (nlssrsrf_persistencemap);
  \draw [match] (nlssrsrf_persistencemap) -- (nlsstrace_persistencemap);
  \draw [match] (nadcslitloss_masterdarkgeo) -- (detdark_masterdarkgeo);
  \draw [match] (detdark_masterdarkgeo) -- (nlssrsrf_masterdarkgeo);
  \draw [match] (nlssrsrf_masterdarkgeo) -- (nlsstrace_masterdarkgeo);
  \draw [match] (nlssrsrf_masternlssrsrf) -- (nlsstrace_masternlssrsrf);

  %% Legend
  \matrix (legend) [draw, fill=gray!15, below right, row sep=0.3cm,
    column 1/.style={anchor=base},
    column 2/.style={anchor=base west}]
    at ([yshift=-1cm]current bounding box.south west){%
      \node (leg_recipe) [recipe] {recipe};
      & \node {recipe}; \\
      \node (leg_calproduct) [calibproduct] {MASTER\_DARK};
      & \node {calib.\ product}; \\
      \node (leg_sciproduct)[scienceproduct] {SCI\_CALIBRATED};
      & \node {science product}; \\
      \node (leg_statcalfile)[statcalfile] {GAIN\_MAP};
      & \node {static calib.\ file};\\
      \node (leg_calfile)[extcalfile]{FLUXSTD\_CATALOG};
      & \node {external calib.\ file}; \\
    \draw [arrow,fill=black] (0,0.4) -- (0,-0.3);
      & \node {processing step}; \\
    \draw [connection_arrow] (-1, 0.5ex) -- (1,0.5ex) node [connection,yshift=0cm]{};
      & \node {product match}; \\
    \draw [connection_arrow, dashed] (-1, 0.5ex) -- (1,0.5ex) node [connection,yshift=0cm]{};
      & \node {optional match}; \\
  };
